title: Places in the Holy Land Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Places in the Holy Land Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Bible places crossword: Bethlehem, Nazareth, Jerusalem, Olivet and the Jordan. KJV clues from Genesis to Acts, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: A puzzle made entirely of place names, which is a particular pleasure in a crossword: Bethlehem, little among the thousands of Judah; Nazareth, of which nothing good was expected; Jerusalem, Olivet, Bethany, Capernaum, Emmaus. Places in the Holy Land maps the whole story geographically instead of chronologically.
It's a good puzzle for anyone who has read the Gospels often but never quite fixed where things happened. The closing verse is Micah's prophecy of the town where it all begins.

clues.text: Little among the thousands of Judah
Town where Jesus was brought up
The city of David, and of the temple

verseText: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel—One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.
